description: This is an abstract PHP class 'AbstractController' serving as a base for other controllers in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It manages HTTP responses, providing methods to create and handle responses, including setting response objects and handling bad requests.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: Abstract class providing foundational HTTP response management functionalities for derived controllers.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current response object, initializing a new one if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, validating its type.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Prepares and returns a response indicating a bad request (HTTP 400).
